text: Starship Flight 15 static fire — quoting @SpaceX: Full duration 33-engine static fire for the Super Heavy booster preparing for Flight 15
zh: 马斯克：星舰第15次试飞的超重型助推器完成33台发动机全时长静态点火测试。

text: October’s full moon, named the Hunter’s Moon, will rise on the night of Oct. 26.
zh: NASA：10月满月“狩猎月”将于10月26日夜间升起。

text: Full duration 33-engine static fire for the Super Heavy booster preparing for Flight 15
zh: SpaceX：星舰第15次飞行的超重型助推器完成33台发动机全时长静态点火。

text: The illegal immigrant population is collapsing. Down 2.3 MILLION+ since President Trump took office.
zh: 白宫：称特朗普上任以来美国非法移民人口减少逾230万。

text: The way to think about this is: How many super smart and dedicated people do you want to hire? And they keep getting better. — quoting: GPUs are still renting ahead of a standard 6-year depreciation schedule (H200 +143%, B200 +111%, H100 +54%, A100 +9%)
zh: 马斯克：评GPU租金仍远高于6年折旧曲线（H200高143%、H100高54%）——该这样想：你想雇多少超聪明又敬业的人？而且它们还在不断变强。

text: Europe has spent generations mastering science, engineering, and manufacturing. That knowledge and expertise can now power AI of its own. “Let’s work together to build Europe’s AI economy and put AI to work.” — @JensenHuang at GTC Berlin
zh: 黄仁勋：在GTC柏林大会上称，欧洲几代人积累的科学、工程和制造能力，如今可以支撑它自己的AI，呼吁共建欧洲AI经济。

text: Welcome to the world, iPhone Duo! It’s such a delight to see the excitement of our customers around the world as they experience the magic of iPhone Duo for the very first time.
zh: 库克：iPhone Duo 正式开售，全球用户首次上手。
